mapper.sql: id, rule_code AS ruleCode, name, category, layer, condition_text AS `condition`, action, action_param AS actionParam, priority, enabled, shadow_mode AS shadowMode, remark, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM risk_rule WHERE layer = #{layer} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_rule ( rule_code, name, category, layer, condition_text, action, action_param, priority, enabled, shadow_mode, remark, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{ruleCode}, #{name}, #{category}, #{layer}, #{condition}, #{action}, #{actionParam}, #{priority}, #{enabled}, #{shadowMode}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE risk_rule SET enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
